case_number: Civil Appeal No.930 of 2023 (@ Special Leave Petition (C) No.10747 of 2016)
summary: Possession claim via registered sale deed; sham transaction defense citing money lending collateral; Fragmentation Act restrictions; Bombay Money Lenders Act applicability; trial court dismissal upheld on reappreciation of title evidence; registered deed weightage vs oral loan evidence; marginal farmer status defense; appellate reversal set aside for concurrent factual findings.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Prevention of Fragmentation and Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1947
Section 8 of Maharashtra Prevention of Fragmentation and Consolidation of Holdings Act
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment restoring trial court dismissal sustained; possession claim rejected based on concurrent findings of sham transaction.
